meta.title: Fix performance and lock issues with fine-grained locking strategy
meta.body_summary: Split coarse-grained tts_lock into tts_lock and audio_playback_lock, move agent network call outside locks, reduce polling interval, increase max threads, claiming ~3x throughput improvement.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot proposed fine-grained locking with narrative speedup; PR closed in ~9 minutes by maintainer with zero review or comment.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 71 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. As a lock optimization PR, the immediate closure without review is inconsistent with a technical acceptance; likely a process gate.

review_details.concern_detail: PR was closed by maintainer 9 minutes after creation with no review comments or feedback of any kind.
review_details.performance_claim: Fine-grained locking reduces blocking from ~500ms to ~100ms, ~3x higher throughput for concurrent requests.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by maintainer immediately without any review; head branch deleted, no merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Despite a plausible lock-splitting refactor with performance narrative, the PR was closed instantly with no maintainer engagement, suggesting a process barrier (e.g., unsolicited agent PRs rejected without review).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body contains before/after narrative and claimed unit test comparison (0.45s vs 0.75s) but no reproduction steps or benchmark artifacts; no maintainer validation attempted.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed with no merge and no feedback.

core_change_summary.description: In main.py, refactored locking to use separate tts_lock (TTS model access) and audio_playback_lock (audio playback), moved agent network call outside locks, reduced polling interval, and increased MAX_THREADS from 2 to 3.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Copilot accidentally committed compiled __pycache__ Python bytecode; .gitignore was updated to exclude build artifacts.
change_trajectory: Initial analysis commit with __pycache__ binary blobs.
Final commit with lock split in main.py and .gitignore update.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with fine-grained locking refactor and .gitignore changes.
Maintainer closed PR within ~9 minutes without any review or comment, deleting the head branch.
